name: scan-to-model
description: Preserve scan evidence, validate depth and alignment, and build reviewable Blender models with requested photographic appearance and portable delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Turn scan evidence into reviewable Blender models.
interface.longDescription: Local skills and tools for source preservation, calibrated depth, surface measurement, rigid registration, Blender review, photographic materials, rendered stills and offline fly-through delivery. Keeps inferred geometry, appearance and metric limits explicit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use scan-to-model to inventory my scans, assess coverage and native depth, and build a source-backed Blender candidate.
